scope: One DayTrigger dictionary lookup with two original getter dependencies. Interpreter/JVM study over declared typed-list, null, UTF-16 and iterator-fault inputs; not ART, exhaustive Unicode, ill-typed erased lists, calendar or lifecycle coverage.
inputEncoding: Strings are exact concatenated four-hex-digit UTF-16 code units; JSON null is a null String. This preserves unpaired surrogates.
exceptionComparisonScope: Only explicitly authored VM-null cases compare the required NPE class and complete event trace; all raw messages are retained. Every other outcome compares the complete record, including injected exception message and reference identity.
